The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock, and the stock tests pass (StockOverviewTest, StockTest, StockAdjustmentTest, StockPerCategoryTest, SlowMovingStockTest: 20 tests, 0 failures). I did not commit.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`**: `findStockLevelsByWarehouse` now has `AND s.quantity > 0` in its query, and its Javadoc says so. This is the query behind `StockService.getWarehouseStock`. The other stock overviews already filter this way.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`**: new test `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft` covers your example. Nuts are taken to zero, screws are set to zero, the list shows only "Bolt 10", and the quantity of nuts in WH-1 is still 0.

The only other caller is the demo output in `DemoScenario`, which just prints the list, so nothing depended on the zero rows.
